title: A refused criterionEvidence selection does not say why: one generic 409 covers a non-holder note, an omitted body, a truncated summary and a locator mismatch
outcome: When termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses a selected criterionEvidence locator, the refusal names the reason for that locator, so the requester knows the fix: cite it from the holder's own note, or supply a smaller or whole record. The acceptance rule itself is unchanged.
acceptance: A test first fails on unchanged code: selecting a non-holder note returns only the generic "selected evidence was not returned whole as a citable record of this task".

Each refusal cause in src/acceptance_evidence_selection.rs (another locator returned, non-holder note, body omitted, summary truncated) returns its own message naming the locator and the cause; for a non-holder note it says that the holder must cite it in a note of its own. Tests cover each cause.
What is accepted or refused is unchanged: the same records are refused, and the existing selection tests pass.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.
